summary: Frontend-only UI test for Telegram Ultra rename + redesign + navigation. Verified login page branding & testids, successful login flow, dashboard header + brand-title 'Telegram Ultra', all 9 desktop segmented tabs switching with active-state highlight, Accounts section toolbar + 500 account cards & badges rendered, mobile viewport (390x844) hides desktop tabs and shows hamburger trigger, mobile-nav-sheet opens containing all 9 mobile nav items + mobile sign-out, and no 'Telegram Pro' text found anywhere. No horizontal overflow at 390px width (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390).

issues: React hydration mismatch warning: server-rendered <input> for password & secret differ from client (server injects style={caret-color:transparent}). Non-breaking but pollutes console. Likely caused by a browser-extension-like attribute or upstream CSS-in-JS/Field component; consider verifying Radix/Field control usage or suppressHydrationWarning on those inputs.

action_items: Investigate & silence the hydration mismatch on /login password + secret inputs (server adds inline style caret-color:transparent that client does not). Not blocking, but visible in console.
critical_code_review_comments: mobile-nav.tsx keeps the sheet in the DOM and slides via CSS transform. This is fine but means Playwright is_visible() will always be true; consider toggling `aria-hidden` and pointer-events (already does pointer-events on backdrop) or removing from DOM when closed to improve a11y and testability.

Login form password/secret inputs trigger SSR/CSR hydration diff (caret-color:transparent). Root cause likely a wrapper (FieldControl) injecting style only on client; consider aligning style or adding suppressHydrationWarning.
seed_data_creation: None - used pre-existing live Neon Postgres data (500 accounts, 7 agents).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All rename + redesign + nav functionality passed. Only known noise is a login-page hydration mismatch console warning on password/secret inputs (caret-color:transparent). Playwright is_visible() cannot detect the mobile sheet close because it uses CSS transform translate-x rather than removing from DOM; verify close via aria-hidden or getBoundingClientRect x-position instead if retesting.
